title: Design System: SalesPatriot DIBBS Solicitation Browser

title.purpose: State notice headings; filter sheet heading at 18px.

body.purpose: Base reading text; notice copy capped at 60ch.

body-dense.purpose: Table cells, filter options, result line.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels above values, table headers.

code.purpose: NSN, solicitation, FSC codes, key hints.

shadows.name: etch
shadows.purpose: Engraved plate edge on plates, buttons, search, table and mobile row plates.

shadows.name: sheet-float
shadows.purpose: Filter side sheet; from below (0 -8px 32px) under 860px. The only floating element.

shadows.name: sheet-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind the open filter sheet.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for all state transitions.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button, segment, FSC row fill changes.

motion.name: field
motion.purpose: Summary field inversion and switch thumb.

motion.name: stale
motion.purpose: Table fade to 60% while a new result set loads.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton loading; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Plate-faced key for actions such as Filters and paging.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--plate); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.7), 0 1px 0 oklch(0.5 0.01 240 / 0.12), 0 1px 3px oklch(0.3 0.01 240 / 0.06); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--plate-sunk); border-color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Underlined text action, e.g. Clear all.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px 0; color: var(--ink-2); font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-strong); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search
components.description: Full-width search plate over the results.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5"/><path d="M10.5 10.5L14 14"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="NSN, solicitation or item"><kbd>/</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--plate); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.7), 0 1px 0 oklch(0.5 0.01 240 / 0.12), 0 1px 3px oklch(0.3 0.01 240 / 0.06); color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: transparent; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: none; padding: 11px 0; font: 400 16px var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); color: var(--ink); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-search kbd { font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Exclusive choice; the checked cell inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--plate); width: 220px; } .ds-seg label { position: relative; } .ds-seg label + label { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg span { display: block; text-align: center; padding: 6px 4px; font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink); transition: background-color 160ms, color 160ms; } .ds-seg label:hover span { background: var(--plate-sunk); } .ds-seg input:checked + span { background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-ink); } .ds-seg input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Filter Stamp
components.html: <button class="ds-stamp">FSC 4820 <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 6px 4px 9px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-ink); border: 0; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 12.5px/1.2 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stamp svg { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-stamp:hover svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Set-aside and Fast-award markers in rows.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-2); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 11.5px/1.3 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-fast { border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Summary Field
components.description: Etched plate field: label, display count, note; pressing filters and inverts.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; background: var(--plate); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.7), 0 1px 0 oklch(0.5 0.01 240 / 0.12), 0 1px 3px oklch(0.3 0.01 240 / 0.06); overflow: hidden; } .ds-field + .ds-field { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; padding: 16px 20px 18px; background: none; border: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-field:hover { background: var(--plate-sunk); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-label { font: 600 11.5px/1.2 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-value { font: 600 44px/0.95 var(--font-lab, "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-note { font: 400 13px var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-urgent .ds-value { color: var(--signal-ink); } .ds-field[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-ink); } .ds-field[aria-pressed=true] .ds-label, .ds-field[aria-pressed=true] .ds-note { color: var(--on-ink); }

components.name: Deadline Gauge
components.description: Return-by cell: text, date, and a bar whose length is days left on a 14-day scale; signal at two days or less.

components.css: .ds-due { display: grid; gap: 1px; width: 128px; margin-bottom: 12px; font: 400 14px var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); color: var(--ink); } .ds-due-text { font-weight: 600; } .ds-due-date { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; } .ds-gauge { display: block; height: 3px; margin-top: 5px; background: var(--rule); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; max-width: 112px; } .ds-gauge span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-due-urgent .ds-due-text { color: var(--signal-ink); } .ds-due-urgent .ds-gauge span { background: var(--signal); }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Equipment Data Plate"**

The interface reads like a MIL-STD-130 identification plate at scale: a satin aluminium ground, etched near-black ink, hairline engraved rules, and small letterspaced caps naming each field above its value. Every surface is a plate; every datum is a labeled field. Codes (NSN, solicitation, FSC) are set in a measured mono so they read as stamped identifiers, not prose.

Density is high and operational. The page is a working instrument for triaging hundreds of RFQs, so hierarchy comes from scale contrast and weight, not from colour or chrome. Colour is almost absent: one cool grey family carries the whole interface, and a single safety orange-red appears only where a deadline is close.

Selection does not add chrome; it inverts. A chosen field, segment, FSC row or active filter becomes an ink plate with aluminium text, the way a stamped plate reads. The world rejects the SaaS card dashboard: no purple accent, no pill soup, no floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Cool aluminium ground, never cream; ink is near-black blue-grey.
Labels are small letterspaced caps above their values.
Codes in Geist Mono with tabular, slashed-zero figures.
One signal colour, reserved for deadline urgency.
Selection is a full ink inversion, not a highlight or outline.
Near-square corners (2-3px) and hairline 1px rules throughout.

rules.name: The Deadline Glows Rule
rules.body: The signal colours (signal, signal-ink) mean "this closes soon" and nothing else. No brand accent, no links, no errors, no hover states in orange.

rules.name: The Stamped Inversion Rule
rules.body: A selected state is an ink fill with aluminium text. Never a tinted background, coloured border or check-badge.

rules.name: The Label Over Value Rule
rules.body: Every datum is named by a small letterspaced caps label sitting directly above it. The label names the field; it is never a decorative kicker over a heading.

rules.name: The Identifier Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything a user would copy into DIBBS (NSN, solicitation, FSC code) is set in Geist Mono; counts and quantities use tabular Barlow figures instead.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Only the filter sheet leaves the plate. Everything else stays etched into the surface; no hover lift, no card shadows.

dos: **Do** keep every surface on the aluminium ground with plate faces and 1px engraved edges at 3px corners.
**Do** name each datum with an 11.5px semi-condensed uppercase label at 0.09em directly above its value.
**Do** show selection by inverting to ink with aluminium text, over 160-180ms on the standard ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
**Do** set NSNs, solicitation numbers and FSC codes in Geist Mono with tabular, slashed-zero figures.
**Do** honour reduced motion: transitions and the shimmer switch off entirely.
donts: **Don't** use the signal orange-red for anything but deadline urgency: not for links, errors, brand or hover.
**Don't** lift elements on hover or give containers floating shadows; only the filter sheet floats.
**Don't** use warm or cream neutrals; the ground stays cool grey.
**Don't** introduce pill-shaped buttons, chips or tags; corners stay at 2-3px.
**Don't** add a second accent hue or tinted selection backgrounds.
